## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

According to DharmaNexus, the poem shares twenty passages with three Pali works, most notably with the commentary *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (sixteen matching units, with the longest span covering segments §3.1–8.7), as well as two didactic Pali nīti anthologies: the *Mahārahanīti* (§6.4–8.6) and the *Dhammanīti* (§7.2–8.6) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records a low-plausibility cross-language alignment between segment §1.2 and the Tibetan translation of the *Ārya-maitreyamahāsiṃhanādanāmamahāyānasūtra* (D0067) [DharmaNexus].
